channel.title: Cboe BZX Exchange Approved and Immediately Effective Rule Filings
channel.description: The latest Cboe BZX Exchange Approved rule filings.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-034
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Chapter 8 of the Exchanges Rulebook relating to investigative and disciplinary matters.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-040
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the Exchanges Fee Schedule to remove text capping the number of Dedicated Cores available to market participants.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-039
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule by i) introducing two quoting tiers to its Add/Remove Volume Tiers and revising the criteria of Add Volume Tier 4; and ii) discontinuing Step-Up Tier 1.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-041
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fees Schedule to adopt a new fee code for Market-Maker Complex orders executed on the complex order book that add liquidity in Penny Program Securities and to amend its Orders Submitted with a Designated Give Up program.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-038
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its rule regarding Trading Permit Holders and associated persons of a Trading Permit Holder who are or become subject to a statutory disqualification.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-037
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its fee schedule entitled Consolidated Audit Trail Funding Fees to establish fees for Industry Members related to certain historical costs of the National Market System Plan Governing the Consolidated Audit Trail (the CAT NMS Plan or Plan) incurred prior to January 1, 2022 that were not previously invoiced via Historical CAT Assessment 1.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-036
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the Exchanges Fee Schedule to remove text capping the number of Dedicated Cores available to market participants.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-035
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Consolidated Audit Trail Funding Fees fee schedule to establish fees for Industry Members related to reasonably budgeted CAT costs of the National Market System Plan Governing the Consolidated Audit Trail (the CAT NMS Plan or Plan) for the period from May 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-033
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fees Schedule to codify a User Fee exemption and the amended definition of Non-Display Usage in its Fee Schedule.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-032
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fees Schedule to codify a User Fee exemption and amend the definition of Non-Display Usage.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-030
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Rule 21.17 to adopt a wide market protection mechanism designed to reduce the risk of orders executing at extreme or adverse prices when the national best bid and offer (NBBO) is determined to be wide.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-029
item.description: The Exchange proposes to modify Rule 11.9(c)(11) and Rule 11.13(a)(4)(C) (D) to describe the behavior of Non-Displayed Orders.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-028
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Rule 21.15(b) to introduce the Exchanges Clock Service.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-026
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the Franklin Ethereum ETF, shares of which have been approved by the Commission to list and trade on the Exchange pursuant to BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4) under an approval order, to permit the Fund to list and trade under the generic listing standards of that rule.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-025
item.description: The Exchange proposes to provide twelve price levels per side for the Cboe One Premium and Summary Depth data feeds.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-023
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Average Daily Quote and Average Daily Order fees to be effective April 1, 2026.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-022
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule to revise the criteria of LMP Tiers 1 and 2.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-020
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF, shares of which have been approved by the Commission to list and trade on the Exchange pursuant to BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4) under an approval order, to permit the Fund to list and trade under the generic listing standards of that rule.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-019
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend Rule 11.22 to introduce its Clock Service.

item.title: SR-CboeBZX-2026-018
item.description: The Exchange proposes to amend its Fee Schedule to adopt a new fee waiver for eligible Internal Distributors.
